notes: Hand-maintained 117-row tsfresh/numpy parity contract (D-01/D-02, Phase 14). Each row names the exact tsfresh.feature_extraction.feature_calculators function + params (reference: 'tsfresh'), or a hand-written numpy/scipy formula (reference: 'numpy/scipy') for names with no tsfresh counterpart. validation/reference/python/gen_tsfresh_features.py reads this file and calls the named calculator DIRECTLY (never tsfresh.extract_features()'s settings-driven convenience API, which silently uses the wrong parameter grid for several of this project's exact choices -- see 14-RESEARCH.md Pitfall 2). status is 'match' once the Rust extract_features() output matches the computed reference value on every fixture series, or 'pending:<owner-plan>' while a later Phase 14 plan (14-02/14-03/14-04) still owns the fix. crates/anofox-fcst-core/tests/tsfresh_features_reference.rs enforces that every pending row still mismatches somewhere (the ratchet) and that every match row matches everywhere, honouring any documented 'deviation' entries. This plan (14-01) adds only the five partial_autocorrelation_lag{1..5} rows (FEAT-01); the remaining 112 names are added by plan 14-02 task 1.
